correctness.rationale: For even cycles the bipartite involution plus conjugation gives an exact pointwise propagator modulus identity. For odd cycles the sole minimal opposite-winding path interference at total length N produces the signed binomial coefficient, higher flux-odd contributions have length N+2 or more, and the convergent Liouville resolvent proves the uniform remainder. Reflection settles the reset site. Symbolic exact-moment verification for 3<=N<=9 and direct finite-matrix reset-resolvent calculations pass but are not substituted for the infinite-family proof.

value.rationale: An experimentally motivated identification problem, magnetic flux-sign discrimination from stationary site populations under stochastic resetting, is solved for all magnetic cycles in an exact even/odd dichotomy. The first available odd-cycle signal is quantitatively identified at every site, with sharp total-variation binomial prefactor and exponent, guiding required reset strength and revealing strong size suppression. This is not a renamed textbook formula, isolated table entry, or arbitrary narrow invariant.
